title: A three-dot toolbar menu holds "Download (PDF)" and "Download (CSV)"
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Inventory Value report is open with rows loaded.
custom_steps:
1. Find and open the three-dot button in the toolbar.
2. Read the menu options.
3. Choose "Download (PDF)", then repeat with "Download (CSV)".
custom_expected:
1. The menu holds an option labeled "Download (PDF)" and an option labeled "Download (CSV)".
2. Each option downloads a file of the current view in the chosen format.
